short.zh: 换一种视野，同样的结构
short.en: A different view, the same structure

t.zh: 换个问题。爬楼梯时，每次可以迈 1 级，也可以迈 2 级。爬到第 n 级，一共有多少种不同的走法？
t.en: A different problem. When you climb stairs, each stride can go up 1 step or 2 steps. How many different ways are there to reach step n?

t.zh: 把每一级台阶当成一个格子，排成一行。第 0 级是地面。
t.en: Treat each step as a cell and lay them out in a row. Step 0 is the ground.

t.zh: 站到第 5 级的最后一步，要么是从第 4 级迈 1 级上来，要么是从第 3 级迈 2 级上来。
t.en: The last stride onto step 5 is either 1 step up from step 4, or 2 steps up from step 3.

t.zh: 机器人这次在台阶这一排上走，从地面（第 0 级）开始，一级一级往右。可是前 2 级离它有两格远，3×3 的视野看不到。所以这一关，你的机器人升级成了 5×5 视野的「远望」。「本格信息」里的「是地面」只在第 0 级是「是」。
t.en: This time the robot walks along the row of steps, starting from the ground (step 0) and moving right one step at a time. But the step 2 below is two cells away, out of reach of a 3×3 view. So for this level your robot is upgraded to Farsight, with a 5×5 view. In the This cell panel, “is ground” is “yes” only on step 0.

t.zh: 拼一块电路板吧。小方那几关你已经发现：零件只认结构，不认名字。爬楼梯的结构，你是不是在哪儿见过？
t.en: Build a board. With Boxy you found that parts care about structure, not names. Have you seen the structure of stair climbing somewhere before?

goal.zh: 每次只能迈 1 级或 2 级台阶，从地面（第 0 级）出发。算出爬到第 4、6、9 级各有几种走法。
goal.en: Each stride goes up 1 or 2 steps, starting from the ground (step 0). Work out how many ways there are to reach steps 4, 6 and 9.

how.zh: 机器人从第 0 级（地面）往上，一级一级地走。站在地面上，算 1 种走法。视野里，红框左边一格是前 1 级，左边两格是前 2 级。
how.en: The robot goes up from step 0 (the ground), one step at a time. Standing on the ground counts as 1 way. In the view, one cell left of the red frame is 1 step down, and two cells left is 2 steps down.

hints.zh: 最后一步可能迈 1 级，也可能迈 2 级：把「前 1 级」和「前 2 级」加起来。
hints.en: The last stride might be 1 step or 2 steps: add up “1 step down” and “2 steps down”.

hints.zh: 地面要算 1 种走法：「是地面」接放行闸的条件口，常数 1 接数口。
hints.en: The ground counts as 1 way: wire “is ground” into a Pass gate’s condition port and a Constant 1 into its number port.

hints.zh: 也可以直接用路线计数器：前 1 级接它的「上」，前 2 级接「左」，是地面接「起」。
hints.en: You can also use the Route Counter directly: 1 step down into its “up”, 2 steps down into “left”, and is ground into “start”.

body.zh: 如果你把路线计数器拿来用了，你会发现：它根本不知道自己在数楼梯，可它算对了。
body.en: If you used the Route Counter, you’ll have noticed: it has no idea it is counting stairs, and yet it got them right.

body.zh: 城市路口和楼梯，表面上毫无关系，但它们的结构一样：每个格子的答案，都来自几个更早的格子，再加上一个起点。看出这种结构，是学会动态规划最关键的一步。
body.en: City crossings and staircases look completely unrelated, but they share a structure: every cell’s answer comes from a few earlier cells, plus a starting point. Learning to see that structure is the most important step in learning dynamic programming.

note.zh: 爬楼梯：第 i 级 = 第 i − 1 级 + 第 i − 2 级，地面算 1 种。
note.en: Climbing stairs: step i = step i − 1 + step i − 2, with the ground counting as 1 way.
